nodes.name: llm_client.py
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible transport for Groq and Google chat models: opens streamed completions, lists model ids, and maps SDK failures to normalised LLMError codes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the OpenAI SDK raw response so rate-limit headers stay available to the quota guard.

nodes.name: exceptions.py
nodes.summary: Shared application exception hierarchy whose messages are safe to show to clients and never echo upstream provider text.
nodes.languageNotes: Every user-facing failure subclasses AppError; LLMError carries a machine-readable code plus a fixed safe message.

nodes.name: llm_service.py
nodes.summary: LLM policy layer that selects a model chain, fails over before the first token, and applies a circuit breaker plus quota guard around provider clients.
nodes.languageNotes: Failover runs only before the first visible token; a second pass ignores soft cooldowns when every model was skipped.

nodes.name: rate_limiter.py
nodes.summary: Per-user token-bucket throttling and a per-model rolling quota guard that lets the LLM layer skip exhausted free-tier models before they return 429.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Offline pytest fixtures: deterministic embedder and reranker fakes, a scripted LLM provider, and a ServiceContainer factory that builds the FastAPI test client.

nodes.name: test_artifacts.py
nodes.summary: Exercises document validation, markdown-to-file rendering, and the chat SSE path that emits an artifact and serves every download format.

nodes.name: test_llm.py
nodes.summary: Covers LLMService failover, circuit-breaker trips, quota-guard skips, think-block filtering, and classify_exception status mapping.

nodes.name: test_retrieval.py
nodes.summary: Offline checks for hybrid ingest and search, owner isolation, embedder and reranker degradation, and atomic index rollback.

nodes.name: OpenedStream
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding response headers, the SDK stream, and its async iterator after a completion has started.

nodes.name: ProviderClient
nodes.summary: Wraps one OpenAI-compatible provider endpoint and opens streamed chat completions or lists model ids under a timeout.

nodes.name: build_provider_clients
nodes.summary: Builds one ProviderClient per provider whose API key is configured, sharing a pooled HTTP client and disabling SDK retries.

nodes.name: wrap_clients
nodes.summary: Normalises a map of SDK clients or existing ProviderClients so tests can inject doubles beside real clients.

nodes.name: chunk_text
nodes.summary: Returns the visible content delta of a chat chunk and ignores reasoning-only deltas.

nodes.name: chunk_usage
nodes.summary: Extracts prompt, completion, and total token counts from a stream chunk when the provider includes usage.

nodes.name: close_stream
nodes.summary: Closes an SDK stream best-effort, awaiting the closer when it returns a coroutine and swallowing shutdown errors.

nodes.name: classify_exception
nodes.summary: Maps OpenAI SDK and HTTP failures to an LLMError code, including retry-after hints parsed from rate-limit headers.

nodes.name: AppError
nodes.summary: Base exception for expected failures whose message is safe to present to the user.

nodes.name: DocumentParseError
nodes.summary: Raised when a document is unreadable, unsupported, or rejected as unsafe input.

nodes.name: FetchError
nodes.summary: Raised when a web page cannot be fetched because of a bad URL, a blocked address, an HTTP error, or size limits.

nodes.name: IngestError
nodes.summary: Ingestion failure that carries a user-safe message and an HTTP status hint, defaulting to 422.

nodes.name: SessionNotFound
nodes.summary: Raised when a session or message id does not exist.

nodes.name: EmbeddingUnavailable
nodes.summary: Raised when no embedding backend can serve the request.

nodes.name: LLMError
nodes.summary: Normalised LLM failure with a machine-readable code, optional model and retry metadata, and a fixed user-safe message.

nodes.name: LLMResult
nodes.summary: Completed generation: joined text, chosen model, fallback list, time-to-first-token, and optional usage.

nodes.name: LLMStream
nodes.summary: Async iterator of visible text deltas that strips think blocks, records usage, and closes the upstream stream when finished.

nodes.name: CircuitBreaker
nodes.summary: Per-model cooldown tracker with soft trips that failover may override and hard trips that hide a model until reset.

nodes.name: LLMService
nodes.summary: Owns the model registry, discovery, and failover chain, opening a stream on the first model that yields visible text.

nodes.name: RateLimiter
nodes.summary: Thread-safe token bucket keyed by caller that returns whether a request is allowed and how long to wait.

nodes.name: QuotaGuard
nodes.summary: Rolling 60-second request and token accounting per model, updated from local usage and provider rate-limit headers.

nodes.name: FakeEmbedder
nodes.summary: Deterministic hashing bag-of-words embedder with a synonym table, used so retrieval tests run without a model download.

nodes.name: FakeReranker
nodes.summary: Deterministic reranker that scores passages by token overlap and can be switched into a failure mode.

nodes.name: _FakeStream
nodes.summary: Async iterator of scripted chat chunks that can raise a canned API error on a chosen step.

nodes.name: FakeProviderClient
nodes.summary: Scripted OpenAI-shaped provider that records calls and returns text, errors, or hangs according to a behaviour list.

nodes.name: settings
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture that builds Settings with isolated temp paths and a cleared provider environment.

nodes.name: tavily_transport
nodes.summary: Builds an httpx mock transport that replays Tavily and Serper search responses for offline web-search tests.

nodes.name: build_container
nodes.summary: Constructs a ServiceContainer with fake embeddings, reranking, and LLM clients, and disposes it after the test.

nodes.name: client_factory
nodes.summary: Returns a callable that mounts the FastAPI app on a TestClient wired to a fresh offline container.

nodes.name: parse_sse
nodes.summary: Parses a Server-Sent Events payload into a list of event names and JSON data objects.

nodes.name: test_validator_rejects_empty_and_over_cap_documents
nodes.summary: Asserts validate_document rejects empty documents and documents that exceed the block cap.

nodes.name: test_when_a_document_is_and_is_not_authored
nodes.summary: Checks the predicates that decide whether a user turn should author, restyle, or save a file and which format they want.

nodes.name: test_five_formats_are_built_from_the_same_document
nodes.summary: Renders one validated document to markdown, text, xlsx, docx, and pdf and checks filenames and content types.

nodes.name: test_awkward_answers_still_become_every_format
nodes.summary: Turns awkward markdown into a document and confirms every download format still builds.

nodes.name: test_a_prose_answer_becomes_a_titled_sectioned_document
nodes.summary: Converts a prose answer into a titled, sectioned document and checks the downloadable markdown.

nodes.name: test_generate_pdf_saves_the_previous_answer
nodes.summary: Streams a chat turn then downloads a PDF of the previous answer through the session API.

nodes.name: test_markdown_becomes_a_document_without_a_second_model_call
nodes.summary: Shows document_source reuses existing markdown or the previous answer instead of calling the model again.

nodes.name: test_file_request_streams_the_answer_then_the_artifact
nodes.summary: Asserts a file request streams answer tokens, then an artifact event, and that the saved file downloads.

nodes.name: test_save_request_files_the_previous_answer_not_export_instructions
nodes.summary: A bare save request files the previous answer rather than the export instructions themselves.

nodes.name: test_i_want_a_pdf_opens_a_file_even_when_the_model_refuses
nodes.summary: A PDF request still produces a download when the model replies with a refusal.

nodes.name: test_every_mode_downloads_every_format
nodes.summary: Parametrized check that each chat mode can download markdown, text, spreadsheet, docx, and pdf.

nodes.name: test_thin_answer_still_downloads_instead_of_failing
nodes.summary: A very short answer still produces a downloadable file instead of an error.

nodes.name: test_download_rate_limit_is_separate_from_chat
nodes.summary: Shows the download limiter can return 429 while a following chat post is still accepted.

nodes.name: test_inline_markdown_is_stripped_in_non_markdown_formats
nodes.summary: Inline markdown markers are removed from text, spreadsheet, docx, and pdf renders.

nodes.name: test_failover_on_rate_limit_and_5xx_and_timeout
nodes.summary: A rate limit, a 5xx, and a timeout each move the stream to the next model before any token is yielded.

nodes.name: test_404_hard_disables_model_and_hides_it
nodes.summary: A 404 hard-disables the model so later availability and the public model list hide it.

nodes.name: test_all_models_failing_raises_normalised_error
nodes.summary: When every model in the chain fails, open_stream raises a normalised all_models_failed LLMError.

nodes.name: test_delete_document_removes_dense_and_lexical
nodes.summary: Deleting a document drops both dense and lexical hits and leaves search empty for that owner.

nodes.name: test_user_id_cannot_escape_index_dir
nodes.summary: A path-like user id is hashed into the index directory and cannot write outside it.

nodes.name: test_index_store_atomic_rollback_on_dim_mismatch
nodes.summary: Adding chunks with the wrong embedding dimension rolls the hybrid index back and leaves lexical search empty.
